location.en: Customer service desk at Harbor Home
location.zh: Harbor Home 賣場的客服櫃檯

goal.en: Return a broken blender and get a working one.
goal.zh: 退回壞掉的果汁機，換一台能用的。

background: bright home goods store customer service counter, white countertop, shelves of kitchen appliances and colorful mixing bowls behind it, polished floor, warm overhead lights

intro.en: Last week you bought a blender to make smoothies in your new kitchen. Now it won't even turn on.
intro.zh: 上禮拜你買了一台果汁機，想在新廚房打果昔。現在它連開都開不了。

intro.en: You bring it back to Harbor Home with the receipt.
intro.zh: 你帶著收據，把它拿回 Harbor Home。

lines.en: Hi there! Welcome to Harbor Home customer service. What can I do for you?
lines.zh: 嗨！歡迎來到 Harbor Home 客服櫃檯。有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

choices.en: Hi. I'd like to return this blender. I bought it last week.
choices.zh: 嗨。我想退這台果汁機。我上禮拜買的。
choices.tip: I'd like to return this. 是退貨的標準說法，再補一句什麼時候買的，店員就能開始處理。

choices.en: Hi. I want to back this blender. It's broken, so I want back.
choices.zh: 嗨。我要退這台果汁機。它壞了，所以我要退。

lines.en: Back it? Like, you support it? Sorry, I'm not sure what you need.
lines.zh: 支持它？你是說你很挺它嗎？抱歉，我不太懂你需要什麼。

story.en: Tyler decides you're a fan of the brand and shows you their newest model. Ten minutes later, you're still holding the broken one.
story.zh: 泰勒以為你是這個牌子的粉絲，開始介紹最新款。十分鐘後，你手上還是拿著那台壞掉的。

fail.why: 「退貨」不是 back，英文說 return：I'd like to return this. 想拿回錢則說 I'd like a refund.

choices.en: Hi. This blender is already break. Can I returning it, please?
choices.zh: 嗨。這台果汁機已經壞了。我可以退嗎？

lines.en: Already break...? Oh, did you break it? Accidents aren't covered, I'm afraid.
lines.zh: 已經弄壞……？喔，是你弄壞的嗎？恐怕意外損壞不在保固範圍內。

story.en: It takes ten minutes to convince Tyler you didn't drop it. The line behind you is not amused.
story.zh: 你花了十分鐘才讓泰勒相信你沒摔到它。排在後面的客人臉色都不太好看。

fail.why: 「已經壞了」是 It's already broken. 或 It stopped working.；is break 不成句，還可能聽成是你弄壞的。can 後面接原形：Can I return it?

lines.en: Sure, I can help with that. Do you have the receipt?
lines.zh: 沒問題，我可以幫您處理。有帶收據嗎？

lines.en: Perfect. And what seems to be the problem with it?
lines.zh: 太好了。那它是出了什麼問題呢？

choices.en: It stopped working after three uses. It made a loud noise first.
choices.zh: 用了三次就壞了。壞掉之前發出很大的聲音。
choices.tip: It stopped working after... 具體說出用了多久、發生什麼事，店員一聽就知道是產品瑕疵。

choices.en: Your blender is junk. It broke so fast. Such terrible quality!
choices.zh: 你們的果汁機是垃圾。這麼快就壞。品質超爛！

lines.en: I'm sorry. I don't make them, but I can help you return it.
lines.zh: 很抱歉。東西不是我做的，但我可以幫您辦退貨。

story.en: Tyler processes your return in silence. The ten percent coupon he gives to unhappy customers stays in the drawer.
story.zh: 泰勒默默幫你處理。他平常會送不滿意的客人九折券，這次那張券一直留在抽屜裡。

fail.why: 抱怨產品可以，但對店員罵 junk、terrible 不會讓事情更快。描述發生了什麼就好：It stopped working after three uses.

choices.en: Nothing happened! I used it normally, I promise. It's not my fault.
choices.zh: 我什麼都沒做！我都正常使用，真的。不是我的錯。

lines.en: Oh, I wasn't blaming you. I just need to know what's wrong with it.
lines.zh: 喔，我不是在怪您。我只是需要知道它哪裡有問題。

story.en: Tyler has to ask three more times before you describe the problem. The line behind you keeps getting longer.
story.zh: 泰勒又問了三次，你才終於說出故障狀況。後面排隊的人越來越多。

fail.why: What seems to be the problem? 只是想知道故障狀況，不是在懷疑你。直接描述問題：It stopped working after three uses.

lines.en: Yeah, that's definitely not normal. Sorry about that.
lines.zh: 嗯，那絕對不正常。真是抱歉。

lines.en: Would you like a refund or an exchange?

choices.en: I'd prefer an exchange for the same model, please.
choices.tip: I'd prefer... 從兩個選項中清楚選一個，同時說明你要換什麼。

choices.en: Yes, please. That would be great. Thank you so much.
choices.zh: 好，麻煩你。那太好了。非常感謝。

lines.en: Yes... to which one? The refund or the exchange?
lines.zh: 好……是哪一個？退款還是換貨？

story.en: Tyler guesses "refund." You walk out with your money but no blender, and the smoothie plan is off again.
story.zh: 泰勒猜你要「退款」。你拿回了錢，卻沒有果汁機，果昔計畫又泡湯了。

fail.why: A or B 的問題不能只回答 Yes，要選一個：I'd prefer an exchange. 或 A refund, please.

choices.en: Can I change it to a new one? I still want a blender.
choices.zh: 可以換一台新的嗎？我還是想要果汁機。

lines.en: Change it? Oh, to a different one? Sure! Our new model comes in pink.
lines.zh: 換掉？喔，換別款嗎？沒問題！我們的新款有粉紅色。

story.en: Before you can explain, Tyler hands you a hot-pink blender. It costs ten dollars more, and it is very, very pink.
story.zh: 你還來不及解釋，泰勒就遞給你一台亮粉紅色的果汁機。它貴了十元，而且真的非常、非常粉紅。

fail.why: 「換一台新的」英文說 exchange it for a new one 或 I'd like an exchange.；change 容易被聽成「換成別款」。

lines.en: Here's a brand-new one, same model.
lines.zh: 這是全新的一台，同款的。

lines.en: Would you like me to test it before you go?
lines.zh: 要我在您離開前先幫您測試一下嗎？

choices.en: Yes, that would be great. Better safe than sorry.
choices.zh: 好啊，那太好了。小心一點總是好的。
choices.tip: Yes, that would be great. 大方接受對方的好意。Better safe than sorry. 是「謹慎為上」的常用說法。

choices.en: Oh, no, don't trouble yourself. It's really okay.
choices.zh: 喔，不用，別麻煩了。真的沒關係。

lines.zh: 喔，好吧！如果您確定的話。

story.en: At home, the new blender turns on, but the lid doesn't fit. Back to Harbor Home tomorrow.
story.zh: 回到家，新果汁機能開機，蓋子卻蓋不上。明天又得跑一趟 Harbor Home。

fail.why: 台灣人習慣先客氣推辭「不用麻煩了」，但英語裡對方會照字面接受。需要的話就直接答應：Yes, that would be great.

choices.en: Sure. And this time, give me one that actually works.
choices.zh: 好啊。這次給我一台真的能用的。

lines.en: Of course. That's why I offered.
lines.zh: 當然。我就是為了這個才提議的。

story.en: Tyler tests it without a word. It works perfectly, but the goodbye is a little chilly.
story.zh: 泰勒一句話也沒說就測試完了。果汁機運轉正常，但道別的氣氛有點冷。

fail.why: 對方主動幫忙，你卻酸一句 this time... actually works，聽起來很不客氣。直接接受好意：Yes, that would be great.

lines.zh: 運作正常。好好享受您的果昔吧！

lines.en: The blender hums smoothly, with no strange noises.
lines.zh: 果汁機運轉得很順，沒有任何怪聲。

story.en: The next morning, you make your first banana smoothie in your own kitchen. It tastes like independence.
story.zh: 隔天早上，你在自己的廚房打了第一杯香蕉果昔。喝起來是獨立生活的味道。

notes.explain: return 是退貨的標準說法。記得帶收據（receipt），很多店沒有收據就不能退。

example.en: I'd like to return these shoes. They're too small.
example.zh: 我想退這雙鞋，尺寸太小了。

notes.explain: stop + V-ing 是「停止做某事」。說 It stopped working after a week. 比只說 It's broken 更具體。

example.en: My headphones stopped working after two days.
example.zh: 我的耳機用兩天就壞了。

notes.explain: refund 是把錢退給你，exchange 是換一個新的或換別的商品。有些店只給 store credit（店內購物金）。

example.en: Can I get a refund, or only an exchange?
example.zh: 可以退款嗎？還是只能換貨？

notes.en: Would you like A or B?
notes.explain: 這是二選一的問題，回答 Yes 對方不知道你選哪個。直接說出你的選擇。

example.en: Would you like a refund or an exchange? / A refund, please.
example.zh: 您要退款還是換貨？／退款，謝謝。

notes.explain: 台灣人習慣先客氣推辭，但在英語文化中，No, it's okay. 會被照字面接受。需要就說 Yes, please. 或 That would be great.

example.en: Would you like a bag? / Yes, please. Thanks.
